title: Kakao's new AI assistant can reorder your groceries, manage schedules from chats
key_facts: Kakao will release an AI assistant inside its KakaoTalk messenger, which has about 50 million users (Korea JoongAng Daily).
The service, Kanana Space, is called up anywhere in KakaoTalk with a two-finger swipe and takes voice or text requests to send messages, manage schedules, search the web and change settings.
In a demo the assistant searched a user's chats, found a regularly ordered brand of bottled water, applied coupons and prepared the order through to payment.
Users still have to approve final actions such as sending messages or making payments.
CEO Chung Shin-a announced it at the ifkakao26 conference in Yongin, Gyeonggi, on Tuesday 13 Oct 2026; a closed beta begins in December and Kakao plans to launch the service next year.
Kakao added OpenAI's ChatGPT to the app last year; it is building its own Kanana models, with simple requests going to smaller models that can run on the phone and harder ones to server-based models.
Kakao also plans Kanvas, a PC service for building and running personal agents, with a closed beta as early as this year.
